verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents charging customers in their local currencies, multi-currency presentment, or how FX conversion is handled or disclosed. The only nearby item is a payout note about a minimum threshold "for your account currency" (polar-docs-14). That shows payouts happen in some account currency, but it says nothing about local-currency charging or transparent FX, so it does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a founder, I can charge customers in their local currencies and settle to my bank in mine with transparent FX handling
